steps.message:
The CoinTracker Pro dashboard has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what's included:

**Sections Implemented**
- **Sticky Header** — Logo, navigation links (Cryptocurrencies, Dashboards, Exchanges, DexScan, Portfolio, Watchlist), and Log In / Sign Up CTAs
- **Top Bar Metrics** — Market Cap ($2.56T ↑1.46%), CTP20 Index ($155.36 ↑1.5%), Fear & Greed (57 Neutral), Altcoin Season (37/100 Bitcoin season)
- **Promotional Banner** — Auto-rotating carousel with 3 slides and dot navigation
- **AI Alerts Bar** — Topic pill + quick-ask suggestion pills
- **Network Filter Tabs** — All Networks, BSC, Solana, Base, Ethereum, More (functional filtering)
- **Category Tabs** — Top, Trending, Watchlist, Prediction Markets, Most Visited, New, More (functional filtering)
- **Index Tracker** — CoinTracker 20 Index (DTFCTP20) with price and % changes
- **Crypto Rankings Table** — 100 rows with all specified columns, proper number formatting, color-coded changes, sparklines, and star-toggle watchlist
- **Table Controls** — Sort by Market Cap / Volume, Filters dropdown, Columns dropdown (toggle visibility)
- **Pagination** — Page buttons with ellipsis, prev/next, and "Showing X–Y of Z assets" info
- **Market Summary** — Full text with Read More / Read Less accordion
- **Info Content** — 5 info cards covering platform description, data methodology, etc.
- **Footer** — Products, Company, Support, Community columns + copyright

**Interactions**
- Category and network tabs switch state and filter the table
- Columns and Filters dropdowns toggle open/close
- Pagination navigates through 100-row pages
- Promotional banner auto-rotates every 5 seconds
- Read More expands additional market breakdown data
- Watchlist stars toggle per row
- Responsive breakpoints for tablet and mobile

**Design**
- Light mode with white/light gray background
- Brand colors: #3861FB (primary), #0D1421 (text), #808A9D (muted)
- Green (#16c784) / Red (#ea3943) for price changes
- Inter font with tabular numerics for financial figures
- Clean, professional Bloomberg-terminal-meets-SaaS aesthetic
